name: Shanghai Huafon Aluminium Corporation
summary: Shanghai Huafon Aluminium Corporation engages in the research and development, production, and sales of aluminum sheets, strips, and foils. The company's products include aluminum heat transfer materials comprising composite and non-composite materials for automobiles and engineering machinery; power plants and heat exchange systems for household and commercial air conditioners; battery materials, including rectangular/square battery casing materials, aluminum strips for strip batteries, battery foils, and aluminum foils for soft-pack batteries; and stamped parts.
